name: Ebata Natsuhi
source:
She was originally a character in the 1.1 expanded edition of Summer Radish Vacation.

After being impregnated by [url=/c15375]Hazama Shun[/url], Natsuhi became the biological mother of [url=/c7634]Ashikaga Inori[/url] Shun's child that she was pregnant with in the ending of Summer Radish Vacation 1.1
